fallback_trigger: No primary configuration reaches zero full-training classification errors.
policy: One frozen random CNN and fixed train-only normalization per dataset. CNN has no classification head, optimizer or supervised updates. Train a width-8 root once per seed, freeze its base network across all correction widths/depths. Primary depth-1 correction tasks/topology fixed by root errors. Deeper fallback is a separate adaptive-topology study. Nonnegative signed parent strengths use verified positive-margin LP when feasible and original BCE fitting otherwise. Pick repeats and deployment using training metrics only. Report active and deployed size, convergence flags and natural plateaus. Repeated test scores are exploratory on existing splits. No guarantee of interpolation or double descent.
